label: / HOW IT WORKS
headline: Three steps. Zero manual entry.
subheadline: AI handles the processing. Your team handles the exceptions.

steps.title: Connect
steps.description: Hook up your email inbox and ERP system. OrderPilot has native connectors for Business Central, Exact Online, Odoo, plus NetSuite and SAP. Setup takes hours, not weeks.

steps.title: Process
steps.descriptionHtml:
Purchase orders arrive by email. OrderPilot reads the document — whatever the format — and extracts every field: vendor, PO number, line items, quantities, prices, delivery dates.

No templates to configure. No rules to maintain. It reads the document the way your best team member would. Faster.

steps.title: Validate & Deliver
steps.descriptionHtml:
Every extracted data point gets checked against your ERP master data. Vendor names matched. Product codes verified. Prices validated.

Clean, validated data lands in your ERP automatically. Your team reviews exceptions only. The routine work is done.

cta.text: See It Work With Your POs
cta.subtitle: Talk to our team about your PO processing challenges and explore if OrderPilot fits.
